notes.split: Predeclared furnished-house development survey only; all views are development and never a held-out test split.
notes.privileged_design: Positions are selected offline from public source geometry around KitchenTable/ChairA and SofaC regions. They are not detector-driven, policy navigation, or later evaluation targets.
notes.attempt_bound: At most two diagnostic set_pose attempts per viewpoint; invalid/unstable placements are retained.
